chunks: So persevere; the promise of God is true; and seek forgiveness for your sin, and chant the praises of your Lord evening and morning.

key_terms.بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ: With the praise of your Lord

ai.seo_question: What are the key acts of worship and spiritual disciplines prescribed in this verse?
ai.summary: In Surah Ghafir, this verse addresses the Prophet Muhammad, linking his personal spiritual discipline—specifically seeking forgiveness for his 'sin' (often interpreted as minor lapses or a sign of humility)—to the broader command of patience for the community. The specific timing of 'evening and morning' (Al-Asiyy wa al-Ibkar) highlights the consistency of dhikr as a means of sustaining spiritual resilience against worldly trials.
